messages:
sam_support: FYI — acme-corp opened a P1. Their latency dashboard panels lost p95/p99 lines after the telemetry rollout last night. Only mean/p50 visible. Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/s/shot/abc123

carmen_cs: thanks — org id?

sam_support: org: acme-corp (org_3482). Dashboard URL: https://console.redwood/acme-corp/dash/latency?panel=request_latency_quantiles

devon_sre: is this only in org-level view or global org-agnostic panels?

sam_support: looks like both the tenant view and global view for requests service. Customer reports spike in error reports but we can see missing series in console.

deploy-bot: metrics-transform v2.1 deployed to prod @ 2077920000 by anna_eng

devon_sre: likely a metrics tag rename in transform. Can you paste the panel query (raw) or run a quick metrics explorer for quantile metrics? e.g. try `query=redwood.request.latency.quantile{quantile="0.95"}`

sam_support: panel query:
```sql
select quantile from metrics where name = 'redwood.request.latency' and agg = 'quantile' and quantile in (0.5,0.95,0.99)
```

anna_eng: digging — we changed histogram->summary mapping in v2.1; it inadvertently removed the `agg=quantile` label for converted metrics. So prometheus-style series ended up as `redwood.request.latency.summary{quantile="0.95"}` but our dashboard expects `agg=quantile` label. Oops.

brian_platform: quick options: 1) revert transform, 2) update dashboard to accept both legacy `agg=quantile` or `summary` metric names, 3) re-emit a compatibility metric. I can push a dashboard fallback patch and enqueue a compatibility re-emission job.

devon_sre: for immediate relief, update the panel query to OR in `name='redwood.request.latency.summary'` and look at `quantile` label. That should restore lines for customers.

brian_platform: PR opened: dashboard-fallback/patch (https://git.redwood/p/dashboard-fallback/pull/123) — will cut a hotfix to prod in ~20m. Also scheduling re-emission job.

sam_support: told customer we have a hotfix rolling and ETA ~30m. will follow up when fixed. :thumbsup:

anna_eng: added migration note to release and will revert label change in next minor if needed. monitoring for regressions.

sam_support: confirmed -- p95/p99 returned for acme-corp's panel at 2078004600. Closing the loop with customer.

carmen_cs: thanks team. Marking as resolved. :white_check_mark:
